title: Determine if String Halves Are Alike
summary: Given an even-length string s, divide it into two halves.
statement: Given an even-length string s, divide it into two halves. Determine if both halves contain the same number of vowels, considering both uppercase and lowercase letters. Return true if they match, otherwise false.
constraints: s has positive even length and may mix letter cases.
Split at the midpoint and compare vowel counts case-insensitively.
hints: Only vowel membership and the fixed midpoint matter.
Count vowels independently in the two equal-length slices.
Build a case-aware vowel set and compare the two membership sums.
Each character belongs to exactly one half, so equal sums are exactly the definition of alike halves.
editorial: Each character belongs to exactly one half, so equal sums are exactly the definition of alike halves.

tests.explanation: Each half contains one o, so they are alike.
The first half has one vowel and the second has two.
